movie.title: Trago Seu Amor
movie.overview: Mia is a self-centered witch who possesses an unusual power: whoever kisses her falls in love with her or falls back in love with the last person they loved. In one of her jobs, however, she ends up falling in love with the woman she was supposed to cast a spell on.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A self-centered witch who causes people to fall in love with a single kiss accidentally falls for the very woman she was hired to spell.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Mia is a self-centered witch with a unique magic: anyone she kisses falls in love with her or reverts to loving their last partner. Hired to perform a routine love spell, her predictable life takes an unexpected turn when she meets her target. Instead of executing her job, Mia finds herself unexpectedly falling for the woman herself. She must now navigate her own selfish tendencies and chaotic powers to understand what real connection truly means.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Mia is an egotistical witch who leverages a very specific romantic magic—a single kiss from her causes the recipient to fall deeply in love with her, or else fall back in love with their most recent partner. She makes a living taking on dubious magical jobs, using her power to manipulate relationships for paying clients without giving much thought to the consequences. However, her routine is completely disrupted when she takes on a assignment targeting an unsuspecting woman. As Mia prepares to execute the spell, she begins spending time with her target and realizes her usual detachment is failing her. For the first time in her life, Mia experiences genuine, unforced affection for the woman she was supposed to enchant. This sudden change of heart causes her plan to unravel, throwing her spellwork and personal life into complete chaos. Torn between her original mission, her reputation, and her emerging feelings, Mia must confront her own selfishness. Ultimately, she is forced to decide whether to rely on magical manipulation or take a risk on authentic, vulnerable love.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Mia is a self-absorbed witch who makes a living manipulating love through her unique magical trait: a single kiss forces anyone to fall in love with her or return to their previous romance. Her cynical, controlled world is turned upside down during a new job when she unexpectedly catches real feelings for the woman she was hired to cast a spell on. Combining comedy, romance, drama, and fantasy, this story follows Mia as she navigates chaotic magic and learns to trade spellbound obsession for genuine affection.

story_structure.climax: Mia must confront her inner dishonesty and make a critical choice between using her supernatural power to guarantee a specific outcome or risking vulnerability by letting authentic emotions take control.
story_structure.conflict: During what should be a routine spellbinding assignment, Mia unexpectedly develops genuine romantic feelings for her target—the very woman she was hired to magically manipulate.
story_structure.resolution: Mia faces the personal consequences of her choice, learning the true difference between artificial magical affection and real, earned connection.
story_structure.introduction: Mia is an extraordinarily self-centered witch who relies on a unique power: anyone she kisses either falls deeply in love with her or reignites their feelings for their most recent love.
story_structure.risingAction: Mia navigates the ethical complexity of her task while attempting to keep her growing feelings hidden, leading to rising tensions between her selfish habits, her duties as a witch, and her genuine affection.
